properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.url
properties.description: JDBC URL of the store's database. No default. It must not carry a user name or password (set username and password instead). Replace * with the store name, for example synapse.data.stores.books.url.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.username
properties.description: User name the store connects with. No default; set it from an environment variable such as SYNAPSE_DATA_STORES_BOOKS_USERNAME.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.password
properties.description: Password the store connects with. May be empty. No default; set it from an environment variable such as SYNAPSE_DATA_STORES_BOOKS_PASSWORD.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.driver-class-name
properties.description: JDBC driver class. Derived from the URL when not set.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.primary
properties.description: Whether the store's beans are the primary ones when the service has several stores. A single store is always primary.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.database-version
properties.description: Version of the database the store's SQL is generated for. Defaults to the vendor module's version.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.allow-ddl-auto
properties.description: Whether ddl-auto may create, drop or update the store's schema at startup.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.migrations.enabled
properties.description: Whether the store's migrations run at startup.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.migrations.locations
properties.description: Where the store's migrations are. Defaults to classpath:db/migration/ followed by the store name.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.migrations.flyway
properties.description: Flyway settings for the store, by Flyway's own key without the flyway. prefix, such as baseline-on-migrate. url, user, password and locations are rejected: Flyway uses the store's DataSource and migrations.locations.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.health.readiness
properties.description: Whether the store's health is part of the readiness group.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.health.timeout
properties.description: How long the store's health indicator waits for a connection.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.hikari
properties.description: Hikari pool settings for the store, bound the way Spring Boot binds spring.datasource.hikari, such as maximum-pool-size. Timeouts are in milliseconds. The pool is named after the store unless pool-name is set. jdbc-url, username, password, data-source-class-name, data-source-jndi, schema, catalog, connection-init-sql, connection-test-query and the data-source-properties user, username, password and url are rejected: use the store's own keys, and name the schema in the url.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.jdbc.template.fetch-size
properties.description: Number of rows fetched from the database at a time by the store's JdbcTemplate. Use -1 for the driver's default.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.jdbc.template.max-rows
properties.description: Maximum number of rows the store's JdbcTemplate reads. Use -1 for the driver's default.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.jdbc.template.query-timeout
properties.description: Query timeout of the store's JdbcTemplate. The driver's default when not set. A duration without a unit is in seconds.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.jdbc.template.ignore-warnings
properties.description: Whether the store's JdbcTemplate ignores SQL warnings instead of throwing.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.jdbc.template.skip-results-processing
properties.description: Whether the store's JdbcTemplate skips results processing when the results are not needed.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.jdbc.template.skip-undeclared-results
properties.description: Whether the store's JdbcTemplate skips undeclared results.

properties.name: synapse.data.stores.*.jdbc.template.results-map-case-insensitive
properties.description: Whether the store's JdbcTemplate reads results into case-insensitive maps.
